As a Staff Software Engineer, Platform you will play a critical role helping to advance Ripple's production infrastructure and release pipelines. Infrastructure Engineers at Ripple are a hybrid of systems and software engineers who support the design and lifecycle of our hosted products. You will work closely with product engineers to support their infrastructure needs, ideally in a self-service environment.

What you’ll do:

• Contribute to platform features across compute, authentication, service discovery, observability, and redundancy
• Implement architectural solutions under the guidance of senior engineers, with a growing awareness of tradeoffs between scale, cost, and maintenance
• Support and mentor junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing
• Help deploy and maintain Ripple's multi-region, multi-provider service platforms with a focus on security and reliability
• Build and improve tooling for automation, monitoring, and instrumentation to reduce operational friction
• Contribute to platform and application lifecycle services, working toward automated, data-driven workflows
• Participate in discussions around scalable, maintainable, and cost-effective solutions
• Learn and apply DevOps and GitOps principles in your day-to-day work

What we’re looking for:

• Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
• 3–6 years of relevant work experience with development background in Go, Python, or Java, with a good understanding of software engineering best practices and system design
• Hands-on experience with cloud providers like AWS
• Working knowledge of orchestration platforms (Kubernetes, Rancher) and containerization technologies for deploying and managing distributed services
• Experience contributing to deployment pipelines using common CI/CD tools
• Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation
• Exposure to Observability platforms leveraging Prometheus and OpenTelemetry, with an interest in building instrumentation patterns and monitoring SLOs/SLIs
• A collaborative team player with a customer service orientation and a willingness to build relationships across teams and cultures
• Good communication skills — written, verbal, and interpersonal

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

• The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
• A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
• Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
• In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
• Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
• We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

• Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
• Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
• Employee giving match
• Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

• R&R days so you can rest and recharge
• Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
• Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
• Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
• Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.
